name: Charm
source:
Charm is a visual novel that consists of five very short episodes from the life of a teenage girl named Eriko. The episodes can be accessed separately from the main menu. In the first episode, Eriko describes her ambiguous feelings towards her relative who she sees as her older sister. In the second episode, Eriko has sexual fantasies about her female teacher. In the third episode (without adult content), Eriko participates in a cosplay. The fourth episode tells about her relationship with a female classmate, while the fifth is dedicated to her ambitions and desire to become popular with the boys.

[Modified from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/charm]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Charm》是一部视觉小说，由少女绘理子生活中的五个极短篇章组成。玩家可以从主菜单分别进入各篇。第一篇中，绘理子讲述自己对某位亲戚的暧昧感情；她把对方视作亲姐姐。第二篇里，绘理子对自己的女教师产生性幻想。第三篇不含成人内容，讲述绘理子参加角色扮演活动。第四篇描写她与一名女同学的关系；第五篇则围绕她的抱负，以及希望得到男生欢迎的愿望展开。

[根据[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/charm]Moby Games[/url]修改]
